chief_complaint: Post‑myocardial infarction follow‑up with hypertension and metabolic syndrome management
history_of_present_illness: The patient suffered an acute NSTEMI on 2019‑04‑24 and has been maintained on secondary prevention therapy including aspirin, a high‑intensity statin, a beta‑blocker, ACE‑inhibitor, and prasugrel. Since then he has continued routine wellness visits but no recent vital signs or laboratory data are available. In early 2020 he contracted COVID‑19 with associated pneumonia, hypoxemia, and a resolved deep‑vein thrombosis treated with anticoagulation. He reports chronic low‑back and neck pain managed with acetaminophen‑codeine. He remains hypertensive, obese, pre‑diabetic, and has metabolic syndrome. Anemia is present but its etiology is unclear. He is employed full‑time at age 75, has a history of higher education, and a criminal record.
